chunks: And it has been narrated in another hadith:
"Regarding one who begins by washing his left before his right, he repeats over his right, then repeats over his left."
And it has also been narrated: "that he repeats over his left."

key_terms.يَسَارِهِ: his left side or left arm
key_terms.يَمِينِهِ: his right side or right arm

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in wudu (ablution) if they wash the left arm before the right?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling for one who reverses the proper order in wudu (ablution) by washing the left arm before the right. One report instructs repeating the right and then the left, while another report mentions repeating only the left, showing transmission of variant rulings on correcting the sequence.
